pages.text: It was midday. The stream was clear as glass. Silver fish sparkled below.
"I want to see the fish up close." Mumu lay on his tummy by the water.
Dodo splashed in. "Splashing calls the fish. I know! Like this!"
She splashed and splashed. Water droplets scattered.
The fish hid away. The stream looked empty.
"They've gone to change clothes before saying hello. They'll be back soon, right?" Dodo looked around.
They waited, but no fish appeared. Only water plants swayed.
Mumu slipped gently into the water and floated still, drifting like a cloud.
Nibble, nibble. Fish tickled Mumu's toes. "Hee hee! Tickly!"
Dodo floated quietly beside him too. The fish nibbled both their toes. Nibble, nibble! Even when they burst into giggles, the fish stayed.
